creative_direction: Show Toru Kazama as his usual young child self, with swept dark hair, a tidy blue jacket, and a small white collar. Turn his shoulders slightly while his face stays toward the viewer. One hand lightly straightens the collar; his expression is earnest with a tiny pleased smile. Keep the background pale mint. Use opaque gouache shapes with soft brush edges, paper texture, and restrained shading. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
